 Unavailable local icons use the bundled default as a data URL.accessed_at_ms `true` ONLY for a saved/imported foreign share (someone else's shared
 Space the user saved) — those rows also carry `source_url`. It does NOT
 mean "this owned Space has an active outgoing share." Owned local Spaces
 are always `false` here regardless of their `spaces.shares` state. The
 web client relies on this: it filters `!is_shared` to populate the
 library, dock, nav rail, recents, and search, so flipping an owned Space
 to `true` makes it vanish from all of those. To surface owned outgoing
 share status, add a separate field and update the client; do not overload
 this one.is_shared The local artifact's `space.json` runtime. Only `static` identifies a
 static artifact; the absence of server actions is not a runtime type. Whether the builder declared that the artifact draws beneath system
 controls on mobile while keeping content clear of the safe-area insets.supports_safe_areas For owned static artifacts, whether the current build is the exact
 successfully published build of an active Cloudflare share.is_current_build_published Canonical share URL for an owned Space's active Cloudflare share; a keyed
 share's carries its share key. Saved rows omit it and use `view_url`.share_url The share page a client loads to view a saved Space: the share's
 authorized link. Owned Spaces omit it and render from this VM.source_url Share target identity, independent of the durable saved-reference key.saved_target_shortcode Whether the local web artifact's built server module declares any typed
 actions (daemon-owned, see migration 0085). `None` for saved/shared
 foreign rows.
